title: Lake Tahoe Small Group Tour from San Francisco
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the beautiful Lake Tahoe on this private tour from San Francisco. By booking this excursion, you’ll be able to enjoy the experience stress-free, knowing your tour guide has taken care of all the details. Luxury transport from the city will be provided, taking you to South Lake Tahoe, and any other places along the way where you’d like to stop. You can stop many times without hesitation. You will be provided with Bottled Water. Any person with any disabilities can travel but under the customer's guidance. You will be picked-up from your doorstep, with no extra charges.
